plan.summary: This first 4-week block builds a simple off-camp strength and power base for boxing with one short weekly session. Week 1 is used to establish a baseline on the main lift so future loading can be adjusted cleanly, and the main build starts in Week 2. With only one 30-minute S&C slot each week, the plan keeps the highest-value work: explosive lower-body power, one main strength lift, a practical upper-body pull, and brief trunk work.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build basic lower-body power and full-body strength with simple, repeatable lifts that do not interfere too much with boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main lifts gradually while keeping total volume tight enough to recover well around sport work.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift more emphasis toward faster, sharper power output while keeping a small dose of strength in place.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Brace hard, stay controlled on the way down, and drive up with solid technique. Stop if depth or trunk position breaks down.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to one hard set of 3-5 reps with clean form. This establishes your baseline for the next block.
